reviews.text: I'm delighted with this meeting. Dr. Diard had a wonderful rapport with my dog. She understands her needs and stress levels and suggests appropriate exercises. She helped me assess her potential for improvement and the possibilities available to her, and she provided me with clear and thorough instructions on how to continue her progress between sessions. Thank you so much.
An exceptional veterinarian who really takes the time to examine the dog and explain things properly to us.
Thank you for your valuable advice and help with Ulysses.

My dog ​​loves hydrotherapy; each session is pure bliss for him.
Vet Pauline handled him with the utmost care.
Very professional. Reachable when needed. Gives valuable advice for exercises to do at home. Highly recommended!

We've been taking our dog to her for rehabilitation for several months now and we're very happy with the results. I highly recommend taking your pets there for rehabilitation; it's super effective and she's very friendly 👊✌️ …
Excellent listening and analysis skills. A lot of time was devoted to our little dog's case. A complete report was sent by email with helpful links...very professional, I highly recommend them.

Dr. Diard offers invaluable advice and brings all his teaching skills to bear for the benefit of both the animal and its owner. It's clear that the animal's well-being is at the heart of his concerns, while also taking into account the constraints of daily life.
When someone combines skills and passion, it's pure joy for us and our furry friends! Don't hesitate to step inside; your pooch will truly come out feeling better!
